text:
mira: Quick sync - we need to finalize the LangChain + LlamaIndex gateway adapter bundle and marketplace onboarding checklist. Target: marketplace listing + partner demo next Wednesday.

alex: what's the most likely delay here? packaging or legal?

mira: both. legal hasn't signed the SOW yet, and eng needs a small compatibility matrix for supported versions + a reproducible smoke test.

sam: i'll take comms and the joint demo script. need a final feature matrix to avoid oversell.

raj: i'll own the adapter test harness and the marketplace artifact (tar + checksum). propose gates:
- SOW pdf attached to partner ticket
- compatibility matrix in partner repo (versions + known gaps)
- CI smoke tests green in staging
- onboarding runbook in docs repo
- signed marketplace bundle uploaded (with checksum)

alex: i'll add an automated workflow: runs smoke, produces results artifact, uploads to Jira. local run for debugging:
```
./eng/tools/run_connector_smoke --connector langchain --gateway adapter-v1
```

integrations-bot: created INTG-5042 -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INTG-5042 (assigned to raj, sam)

mira: legal ETA?

sam: legal said 48 hours for SOW review if no major edits. i'll push to them and flag security/data handling clause.

raj: demo env ready. need a stable model checksum and the demo dataset. i'll DM the S3 path and will post the smoke logs here once the run completes.

alex: CI job added: https://github.com/redwood/orchestrator/actions/runs/112233 - it triggers smoke and posts a summary to INTG-5042.

mira: great. owners: legal (sam), eng (alex + raj), comms (sam). next quick checkpoint tomorrow 9:30am PT. please bring: PR for compatibility matrix, runbook draft, and marketplace bundle details (name/version/checksum).

sam: drafting co-announcement headline: "Redwood + LangChain: plug-and-play gateway adapters for scalable connectors". will share draft and one-slide demo script here by EOD.

raj: smoke run started 11:07am PT. failing on an env var for credentials; will re-run after fix and post artifacts.

alex: minor note - packaging needs to include a README with minimal config example and a compatibility table that lists tested orchestrator versions.

mira: ok team, keep updates in INTG-5042. attach signed SOW there once it lands. thanks :)
